Downloaded via public links from the official asset page. No account, fee, installation, user information transmission, or API access bypass. Original 4K downloads retained only as local source assets, not shipped. Runtime total: 1,656,641 bytes. Texture represents 2.5m-wide pavement. Normal map is OpenGL convention.

All remaining city geometry and procedural textures are authored locally; Three.js remains under its bundled MIT license.
